label: TP
reason: The header name provided by the user flows through getHeaderNames() -> nextElement() -> param assignment -> doSomething() which applies Base64 decoding/encoding to the header name, and then the resulting value is used to construct a file path. The file path is then used in new File(fileName), making it vulnerable to path traversal. The encoded header name can be crafted to traverse directories.

evidence.note: User-provided header name is extracted via getHeaderNames()
Header name assigned to param variable
doSomething() applies Base64 encode/decode to param, producing bar
bar is used to construct fileName and passed to new File()
